scientific_limitations: Only uncorrected unit-step BE and BDF2 convolution coefficients are analyzed; initial corrections are not included.
Eventually positive weight differences do not imply positivity at every index or PDE-solution comparison.
Nonnegative integrable order densities must have a power-law endpoint at order one; signed and atomic measures lie outside scope.
Historical priority may be affected by a more general existing coefficientwise asymptotic or transfer theorem; no independent verification has been performed.
